entries.title: Revelation of John 13:1
segments: A beast. A great world-power, hostile to the church, as the nondescript beast in
.  It appeared to the early church as the Roman empire, the persecuting power of the world.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:2
segments: Leopard, etc.  The beast is a composite of all the world-powers.  See

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:3
segments: One of his heads, etc.  This may refer to some event in the life of Nero.  At any rate, it intimates that the power of evil would seem to prevail in spite of some victories of truth; and that successful evil would be held in admiration by mankind.  Men would worship Satan, because Satan maintained the power of the world.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:4
segments: Authority unto the beast. Satan gave his power to the world, as it was the enemy of the church.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:6
segments: Tabernacle, even them, etc.  The tabernacle, even more than the Temple, is a type of heaven.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:7
segments: The saints. The same as 'the rest of her seed' in

 Here is the patience. That is, here is the reason why the saints should be 'patient' (stedfast) in tribulation.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:11
segments: Another beast. The earthborn beast is less repulsive than the beast which rose up from the sea.  It would seem to be a partially Christianized, but really pagan power, deceiving man.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:14
segments:
.
 

 
 Make an image.  Very probably a reference to the image of the emperor of Rome, but it means any worship of evil principles, even under the guise of right.

entries.title: Revelation of John 13:18
segments: Six hundred and sixty and six. It seems presumptuous to attempt to explain the number 666.  Probably it is a cipher, the key to which has been lost.  There may have been many things in this book, which were made clear to early readers by oral interpretations now lost.
